svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A volcano plot of differential expression. Most genes cluster near the centre bottom (no change, not significant, grey). Genes significantly up in treated sit to the upper right in red; genes significantly down sit to the upper left in blue. A dashed horizontal line marks the significance threshold.
svg.text: Volcano plot: which changes are big AND certain
